theme_title: Airtel Payments Bank IPO in pipeline? Bharti Airtel payments business eyes D-Street debut, says report
summary: Airtel Payments Bank could become a much larger financial services business and may pursue an IPO in three to four years, Sunil Bharti Mittal said. The bank has nearly 100 million users and is targeting ₹10,000 crore in revenue and deposits, and ₹1,000 crore in profit.

theme_title: JSW Motors partners with Amazon Web Services to host connected-car data
summary: JSW Motors has announced a partnership with Amazon Web Services to host its connected-car platform in India. The data generated will remain under the ownership of JSW Motors, ensuring local control. The automaker is preparing to launch its first vehicle manufactured in Maharashtra in the coming months. Additionally, Tata Elxsi will handle localisation of the telematics control unit as connectivity will operate on Airtel’s network.
